question: How much energy is released from 1 gm of fat?
solution:
The correct answer is **__9 calories__**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **1 gram **of **fat** provides **9cal or 37.8 J** of energy. (1 cal = 4.2 Joules)
